name: open-computer-use
description: Visual-first macOS and Windows Computer Use MCP that observes real screenshots and sends native input events.

interface.shortDescription: Control macOS or Windows from real screenshots
interface.longDescription: Uses real macOS or Windows screenshots as the UI source of truth, renders a visible virtual cursor, and sends native mouse, keyboard, and scroll events without reading DOM or Accessibility/UI Automation trees.
defaultPrompt: Call observe_screen before acting and treat the latest screenshot as the UI source of truth
Call move_mouse and visually verify the virtual cursor hotspot before every click
Verify the fresh screenshot returned after every action before continuing

permissions.reason: Launch the installed Visual Computer Use stdio MCP executable.
Send user-requested native mouse, keyboard, and scroll events to macOS or Windows applications.
